localizedDescription.schinese:
依赖 DTMAPI。
将官方存档界面扩容为 12 个总槽位，禁用后不会删除额外存档文件。
localizedDescription.tchinese:
依賴 DTMAPI。
將官方存檔介面擴容為 12 個總槽位，停用後不會刪除額外存檔檔案。
localizedDescription.english:
Requires DTMAPI.
Expands the official save UI to 12 total slots. Extra save files are not deleted when the mod is disabled.
